scope.boundary: Local shared header and route-section extension; existing tokens, routes, tools, and global documentation remain authoritative.

components.name: Knowledge section navigation
components.description: Localized route links with a 44px minimum height, ink/paper active state, aria-current, and visible keyboard focus. This static English preview represents the Terms route; production uses LocalizedLink and translation keys.
components.html: TermsPersonalities
components.css: .ds-knowledge-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.5rem; margin-top:1.5rem; padding-bottom:1rem; border-bottom:1px solid hsl(var(--border-hairline)); } .ds-knowledge-link { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; padding:0.5rem 1rem; font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:var(--text-13); line-height:var(--text-13--line-height); font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); transition-property:color,background-color,border-color,text-decoration-color,fill,stroke; transition-duration:150ms; transition-timing-function:cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-knowledge-link:not([aria-current]):hover { background:hsl(var(--muted)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-knowledge-link[aria-current="page"] { background:hsl(var(--foreground)); color:hsl(var(--background)); } .ds-knowledge-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--foreground)); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Knowledge joins the terms index and personalities directory through one shared header. It inherits the incumbent editorial paper/ink identity; comprehension and explicit wayfinding guide this Read surface.
keyCharacteristics: One Knowledge heading with two visible, URL-backed sections.
Localized labels, ordinary navigation history, and stable chrome during loading and failure.
Existing discovery and contribution tools remain within their owning section.
dos: Do preserve localized, URL-backed section navigation and visible labels.
Do retain PageContainer alignment and the existing semantic tokens.
Do keep the shared heading and section links available during loading and failure.
Do retain each section's tools, filters, contribution controls, and individual URLs.
donts: Don't add a second page h1 below Knowledge.
Don't merge term and personality results into one undifferentiated directory.
Don't introduce a new route, visual identity, palette, radius, or shadow for this extension.
